reason: An attribute plus a part: the bearer is the lobe of the named organ (corolla, calyx, lamina), with length (PATO_0000122) and a magnitude; numbers follow docs/odp/02 and 05.
Negation of PATO_0001962 involute, as 'unlobed' = not lobed.

target: new: conjunction of two values (papillose FLOPO:0991059 and rugose PATO_0001359)
reason: A zone at the base of the sepals that is both papillose and transversely wrinkled; both values hold at once, so it is not a continuum. It also needs the basal region of the bearer.
PATO hispid is 'covered with stiff or rough hairs'; 'sparse' and 'few' stay as qualifiers of the record.
This is the season in which the inflorescence appears, not a quality of its form. It depends on climate and has no stage or quality term to rest on.
Scabrulous means minutely scabrous; FLOPO:0991058 already lists scaberulous and scabridulous as related synonyms.
The margin of the bract or involucre is white: a region of the bearer with a colour, not a new value.

target: docs/odp/00-part-and-quality.md: vascular bundle (PO_0005020) of the bearer + inconspicuous (PATO_0000464)
reason: The veins of the organ are not clearly visible. This combines the 'nerved' rule (vein present) with the 'obscure' rule (PATO_0000464 inconspicuous) on the vein as bearer.
'Sexual condition autoecious' is the bryophyte sexual system, spelt as in seed-plant terms; FLOPO:0991093 covers it.
An attribute heading over unrelated pores (anther pores, cell pores of moss leaves) with no bearer class; the size values need the pore as a part first.
'Dorsal sepal 4–5.5 mm' is the length (PATO_0000122) of the sepal in the dorsal position, a position of the bearer in its series; 'atteignant dorsalement' measures the same length along the back.
Velvety is an exact synonym of PATO velutinous; 'pubescent' adds nothing. The silky ('sedoso') examples belong to another value.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum/compound: acuminate PATO_0002228 + apiculate, nearest mucronulate FLOPO:0991055)
reason: A compound of two apex values: acuminate and ending in a short point. PATO has apiculate only as a synonym of the attribute sharpness, so the second value should not be grounded to PATO_0000944.
A compound of two margin values; 'finely serrate' could also be read as serrated with the diminutive as approximately.
A compound of two outline shapes, written like 'linear-lanceolate'; it is handled by the continuum relation.
Isocotylous means the cotyledons are equal in size. The bearer is the cotyledons (PO_0020030) of the embryo, and 'sub-' gives value_qualifier approximately.
A compound of two shapes with a transcription split ('ob lanceolate'); it is handled like 'linear-lanceolate'.

target: new: conjunction of two values (pubescent PATO_0000455 + hair colour orange FLOPO:0988002, 'ferrugineux' RELATED)
reason: Covered with short rust-coloured hairs: a pilosity of the organ plus a colour of its hairs (trichome PO_0000282). The second example is a fragment.
A compound of two 3-D shapes (narrowly bell-shaped and tubular), as for the capitula of Asteraceae.
A compound of two solid shapes; ellipsoid and ovoid are synonyms of the PATO terms named. The ovoid side should move to the PATO term when pato#627 is merged.

target: new: conjunction of two values (velutinous PATO_0104041 + grey PATO_0000950 of the indumentum)
reason: A velvety indumentum that is grey: two attributes of one bearer, so it is neither a continuum nor a new value.
The perianth is of two dissimilar whorls (calyx and corolla). That is FLOPO dimorphic, inhering in the set of perianth members (bearer perianth PO_0009058).
This is a heading that names the part ('sulcate', 'lineate' are its values), wrongly transcribed on whole plant; the surface of the stem is its epidermis.

label: persistent
definition: A shedability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's remaining attached and not falling off after the stage at which comparable structures are usually shed, as a style or calyx on the fruit.
reason: The bearer is the style (PO_0009074), part of the fruit; the quality is 'persistent', which has no term in PATO or FLOPO. PATO_0001732 non-deciduous inheres in a whole plant. This would be a sibling of FLOPO:0991181 marcescent; check first that no term already covers it.
A coarctate inflorescence is contracted and crowded, so PATO condensed applies; this rule is for inflorescences only. The French vein sense ('nervures coarquées') is unclear and is left out.
'Bi-' gives a count: two mucros at the apex or base, as in '5-nerved', with mucronulate (FLOPO:0991055) as the value.

target: new: conjunction of two values (scabrous FLOPO:0991058 + ciliate margin, fringed PATO_0040008)
reason: The margin or keel is fringed with short, rough, stiff hairs; both values hold. PATO_0001408 ciliated is the cellular cilium and must not be used.
A leaf blade base that is straight across (beside 'slightly cordate') is truncate; the bearer is leaf lamina base (PO_0008019).
Veins joining one another means they anastomose. When a second part is named ('joining the main veins'), the relation goes to docs/odp/09.
Lateral veins arching and joining before the margin give brochidodromous venation; the bearer is the leaf lamina or leaflet, not the single vein.
